name: duplicate-slot-property-rejected
description: Two slots naming the same property, one bound and one unbound, are refused: the property sort is not a total order over duplicates, so retaining both would let input order pick a winner.
notes: Pairs one bound and one unbound slot on the same property, rather than two bound slots, because slot retention keeps the unbound entry in the projection: the refusal has to hold for every binding-state combination sharing a property, not only the both-bound case.
